edits.previous: The compiler and reviewed contract admit three canonical index kinds: an unbounded `Nat`, `Bool`, and `String`. They are serialized as unsigned decimal, `true`/`false`, and exact Unicode-scalar text respectively; zero, the empty string, and supplementary characters are valid. Lean reduces a closed expression before recording it, so `1 + 2` and `decide (1 < 2)` become `3` and `true`. Open or opaque values are rejected. `Int`, `Char`, fixed-width or platform-width integers, `Fin`, functions, proofs, instances, and other index types require a separately reviewed representation and are not inferred from a host value. The [native-PHP](../evidence/checked-record-value-index-php-promotion-20261019.md), [PHP-Wasm](../evidence/checked-record-value-index-php-wasm-promotion-20261020.md), [Perl](../evidence/checked-record-value-index-perl-promotion-20261020.md), and [Python](../evidence/checked-record-value-index-python-promotion-20261020.md) value-index archives exercise all three closed forms at top-level copied checked-record parameter and result sites; the broader installed rollout remains separately tracked.

Results contain copied payload fields with proofs erased. Both ordinary and independently reviewed packages, including standalone result-only packages, passed installed checks. The tested Packet carries a Fin 10 digit and a checked Nat Subtype word as BigInteger values. Holder nests Packet, and ChoicePacket carries it in the active Choice branch. Generated Java and Kotlin adapters apply the exact Packet and nested Word constructors selected at each direct, repeated, array, list, option, tuple, result, Holder and Choice input site. Rejected calls preserve the complete caller graph and later valid calls recover. Packet arrays and options returned by Lean contain proof-free payloads without input-constructor selections. The tested Span, Ticket and Stamped inheritance chain remains a chain of nested parent subobjects rather than flattened fields. Generated adapters preserve the parent aliases and public nominal identities, erase the ordered, linked and stamped proof fields, apply the exact per-site Span, Word, Ticket and Stamped constructors in dependency order, retain independent choices for repeated parameters, check the nested Fin 8 mark, preserve rejected caller values and recover on the next valid call. Full packages check inputs and proof-free results; result-only packages project the same inherited payloads without input-constructor metadata. The tested checked-record graphs preserve nominal identity through a self-recursive Packet and a mutually recursive Envelope ↔ Step pair, including aliases, Array and Option wrappers, active variant branches, exact Nat Subtype constructors and Fin 3 fields. Generated adapters validate every selected input site in dependency order, erase proof fields, expose constructor-free copied results, preserve rejected caller graphs and recover on the next valid call."
